title: Recolor each component by its size

racket_target.raw_code: (rule! (lambda (g) (let ((objs (objects g 0))) (for/fold ((out g)) ((o (in-list objs))) (recolor-cells out (obj-cells o) (cond ((= (obj-size o) 1) 1) ((= (obj-size o) 2) 2) ((= (obj-size o) 3) 3) ((= (obj-size o) 4) 4) (else 6)))))))
